label: accepted

evidence.V1: Silhouette reads as a barrel from front, 3/4 and top: bulged body, flared rim, two hoop bands and nail nubs break the outline; front outline symmetric (A15 X/Y error 0.0).
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big bulged stave body, medium chunky gold hoops and chamfered rim lip, small ink nails (4 per hoop) plus alternating stave values.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised barrel: strong belly bulge, tapered ends below/above the hoops, oversized hoops and rim; reads toy-like rather than a straight primitive cylinder.
evidence.V4: Consistent bevels: hoops have chamfered top/bottom edges that catch a highlight, rim lip chamfered, nails faceted; matches the ~0.045 kit chamfer look.
evidence.V5: Mostly clean smooth shading on staves and hoops, but the inner rim edge is notched/scalloped at stave seams (top view and lid flat close-up) with a dark seam line and a bright smear where the lip meets the recessed head.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one wood hue in 3 values (light/dark staves, dark interior), gold accent hoops, ink nails; colourways swap the hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 1728 tris vs medium target 2000 (ceiling 4000): at or under target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material, kit gold + ink accents, chamfered edges, smooth shading; nails seated (0.055 penetration, no gap); looks like the same kit as the PipeRun anchor.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, Hull collision (or Cylinder part), CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; all gates A1-A18 pass.

evidence.V1: Front and silhouette outline read instantly as a barrel (bulged belly, rolled lip, hoop and nail nubs on both sides, symmetric outline, A15 X/Y error 0.0); top view reads as a hooped ring, so it is readable from all angles.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big bulged stave body, medium chunky gold hoops and rolled top lip, small hex ink nails (4 per hoop) that the earlier version lacked.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised barrel: pronounced belly, thick gold bands and an over-rounded lip give a chunky toy read, with no stiff-primitive look; nothing floating (nails seated, gap 0).
evidence.V4: Hoops carry a consistent chamfer that catches a highlight band on their top and bottom edges, the lip is rounded and the nails are bevelled hex heads; bevel scale looks consistent across parts.
evidence.V5: Visible minor artifact: the inner edge of the opening is wavy/notched rather than a clean ring (top view, lid close-up), and a light pinch highlight sits on the inner lip at the top of the lid studio close-up; the stave body and hoops themselves shade cleanly.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one wood hue in about three values (light stave, dark stave, dark interior) plus gold accent and ink-dark nails; the painted colourways keep the same structure.
evidence.V7: 1728 tris against a medium-class target of 2000 (ceiling 4000), at or under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold for hoops, ink-dark nails, warm brown as the single hue, smooth shading with chamfered edges; matches the kit style of the pipe anchor.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: Anchored, Hull collision (or Cylinder part), CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; all gates A1-A18 pass.

gate_report lists 64 cross-shell overlaps (nails pushed 0.055 studs into hoops; intentional and allowed, noted only)
top_fixes: Make the inner rim lip one continuous chamfered ring (or weld stave tops) so the opening edge is a clean circle without notches at stave seams
Add a small chamfer/fillet between the inner rim wall and the recessed head to remove the dark seam and the specular smear
Optionally add a shallow geometric groove at stave seams so stave breaks read in silhouette lighting, not only via vertex colour
Clean the inner head seam: match the head disc segment count/radius to the inner stave wall and add a single even chamfered croze so the top view shows a clean concentric ring
Smooth the stave bulge faceting (weighted normals or a couple more height loops on the bulge) so the staves read as one continuous curve
Optional small-scale detail for richer hierarchy: shallow stave grooves or a bung plug on one stave, kept within the 2000-tri target
Rebuild the inner lip/opening as a clean concentric ring (consistent inner radius per segment, no notches) and fix the normals there to remove the pinch highlight
Raise the radial segment count slightly on the lip and hoops (budget allows: 1728 of 2000) so the outline reads round in close-ups
